panels.title: Panel 1 — Strategy Leaderboard (Ranked by Bankroll & Net Profit)
panels.description: Comprehensive strategy standings leaderboard ranked by current bankroll cash and realized net profit. Columns: 'Participant' (reporting operator node or 'local'), 'Experiment' (cohort ID), 'Strategy' (strategy slug), 'What This Strategy Does' (plain-English trading behavior), 'Bankroll ($)' (available portfolio cash), 'Gross Profit ($)' (realized profits before exchange fees), 'Fees Paid ($)' (cumulative exchange fees incurred), 'Net Profit ($)' (realized profit after fees), 'Return (%)' (percentage return on initial balance), 'Total Trades' (completed trades), 'Wins'/'Losses'/'Win Rate (%)' (win performance metrics), 'Cohort Status' (active/draining/completed), and 'Last Updated (UTC)' (timestamp of last state update).

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
    s.participant_id AS "Participant",
    s.experiment_id AS "Experiment",
    s.strategy_id AS "Strategy",
    s.display_label AS "What This Strategy Does",
    ROUND(s.cash_dollars, 2) AS "Bankroll ($)",
    ROUND(COALESCE(s.gross_realized_pnl_dollars, s.realized_pnl_dollars), 2) AS "Gross Profit ($)",
    ROUND(COALESCE(s.total_fees_dollars, 0.0), 2) AS "Fees Paid ($)",
    ROUND(s.realized_pnl_dollars, 2) AS "Net Profit ($)",
    ROUND((s.cash_dollars - e.start_balance) / e.start_balance * 100.0, 2) AS "Return (%)",
    s.trades AS "Total Trades",
    s.wins AS "Wins",
    s.losses AS "Losses",
    ROUND(s.win_rate_pct, 1) AS "Win Rate (%)",
    e.status AS "Cohort Status",
    strftime('%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%SZ', s.updated_at_ms / 1000.0, 'unixepoch') AS "Last Updated (UTC)"
FROM v_grafana_standings s
JOIN v_grafana_experiments e ON s.participant_id = e.participant_id AND s.experiment_id = e.experiment_id
WHERE ('$participant' = 'All' OR s.participant_id = '$participant')
  AND ('$strategy' = 'All' OR s.strategy_id = '$strategy')
  AND ('$experiment' = 'All' OR s.experiment_id = '$experiment')
  AND ('$cohort_status' = 'all' OR e.status = '$cohort_status')
  AND s.trades >= CAST('$min_trades' AS INTEGER)
ORDER BY s.cash_dollars DESC, s.realized_pnl_dollars DESC;

panels.title: Panel 2 — Strategy Bankroll Over Time ($)
panels.description: Time-series trajectory of each strategy's bankroll over time ($), starting from initial allocation ($100 default) and tracking cumulative net PnL across closed trades. Partitioned by (participant_id, experiment_id, strategy_id) to prevent distinct cohort lines from crossing. Uses RFC3339 UTC time formatting.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
    strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ', t.closed_at_ms / 1000.0, 'unixepoch') AS time,
    (t.participant_id || ' : ' || t.experiment_id || ' : ' || t.strategy_id) AS metric,
    ROUND(e.start_balance + SUM(t.pnl) OVER (
        PARTITION BY t.participant_id, t.experiment_id, t.strategy_id
        ORDER BY t.closed_at_ms, t.trade_id
        ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
    ), 2) AS bankroll
FROM v_grafana_trades t
JOIN v_grafana_experiments e ON t.participant_id = e.participant_id AND t.experiment_id = e.experiment_id
WHERE t.closed_at_ms IS NOT NULL
  AND ('$participant' = 'All' OR t.participant_id = '$participant')
  AND ('$strategy' = 'All' OR t.strategy_id = '$strategy')
  AND ('$experiment' = 'All' OR t.experiment_id = '$experiment')
  AND ('$cohort_status' = 'all' OR e.status = '$cohort_status')
ORDER BY t.closed_at_ms ASC, t.trade_id ASC;

panels.title: Panel 3 — Live Open Positions & Watching Status
panels.description: Live inventory of open positions currently in flight, unpacked from JSON structures. Columns: 'Participant', 'Experiment', 'Strategy', 'Position State' (WATCHING = active contract awaiting exit criteria; SETTLING = closed market held to expiration awaiting official resolution), 'Cycle', 'Contract Ticker', 'Direction' (UP/DOWN), 'Contracts Held', 'Entry Price ($)', 'Total Cost ($)', 'Take-Profit Target ($)', 'Stop-Loss ($)', and 'Updated Time (UTC)'.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
    s.participant_id AS "Participant",
    s.experiment_id AS "Experiment",
    s.strategy_id AS "Strategy",
    'WATCHING' AS "Position State",
    json_extract(s.watching_json, '$.cycle_id') AS "Cycle",
    json_extract(s.watching_json, '$.ticker') AS "Contract Ticker",
    UPPER(json_extract(s.watching_json, '$.side')) AS "Direction",
    CAST(json_extract(s.watching_json, '$.n') AS INTEGER) AS "Contracts Held",
    ROUND(CAST(json_extract(s.watching_json, '$.entry_price') AS REAL), 4) AS "Entry Price ($)",
    ROUND(CAST(json_extract(s.watching_json, '$.cost') AS REAL), 2) AS "Total Cost ($)",
    ROUND(CAST(json_extract(s.watching_json, '$.limit_at') AS REAL), 4) AS "Take-Profit Target ($)",
    ROUND(CAST(json_extract(s.watching_json, '$.stop_at') AS REAL), 4) AS "Stop-Loss ($)",
    strftime('%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%SZ', s.updated_at_ms / 1000.0, 'unixepoch') AS "Updated Time (UTC)"
FROM v_grafana_standings s
JOIN v_grafana_experiments e ON s.participant_id = e.participant_id AND s.experiment_id = e.experiment_id
WHERE s.watching_json IS NOT NULL
  AND json_valid(s.watching_json)
  AND json_extract(s.watching_json, '$.ticker') IS NOT NULL
  AND ('$participant' = 'All' OR s.participant_id = '$participant')
  AND ('$strategy' = 'All' OR s.strategy_id = '$strategy')
  AND ('$experiment' = 'All' OR s.experiment_id = '$experiment')
  AND ('$cohort_status' = 'all' OR e.status = '$cohort_status')

UNION ALL

SELECT
    s.participant_id AS "Participant",
    s.experiment_id AS "Experiment",
    s.strategy_id AS "Strategy",
    'SETTLING' AS "Position State",
    json_extract(j.value, '$.cycle_id') AS "Cycle",
    json_extract(j.value, '$.ticker') AS "Contract Ticker",
    UPPER(json_extract(j.value, '$.side')) AS "Direction",
    CAST(json_extract(j.value, '$.n') AS INTEGER) AS "Contracts Held",
    ROUND(CAST(json_extract(j.value, '$.entry_price') AS REAL), 4) AS "Entry Price ($)",
    ROUND(CAST(json_extract(j.value, '$.cost') AS REAL), 2) AS "Total Cost ($)",
    ROUND(CAST(json_extract(j.value, '$.limit_at') AS REAL), 4) AS "Take-Profit Target ($)",
    ROUND(CAST(json_extract(j.value, '$.stop_at') AS REAL), 4) AS "Stop-Loss ($)",
    strftime('%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%SZ', s.updated_at_ms / 1000.0, 'unixepoch') AS "Updated Time (UTC)"
FROM v_grafana_standings s
JOIN v_grafana_experiments e ON s.participant_id = e.participant_id AND s.experiment_id = e.experiment_id,
json_each(s.settling_json) j
WHERE s.settling_json IS NOT NULL
  AND json_valid(s.settling_json)
  AND s.settling_json != '[]'
  AND ('$participant' = 'All' OR s.participant_id = '$participant')
  AND ('$strategy' = 'All' OR s.strategy_id = '$strategy')
  AND ('$experiment' = 'All' OR s.experiment_id = '$experiment')
  AND ('$cohort_status' = 'all' OR e.status = '$cohort_status')
ORDER BY "Updated Time (UTC)" DESC, "Participant" ASC, "Strategy" ASC;

panels.title: Panel 4 — Recent Trade Tape (All Executed Paper & Cohort Trades)
panels.description: Recent Trade Tape logging every paper and cohort trade executed across strategies. Columns: 'Trade #' (unique ID), 'Opened Time (UTC)', 'Closed Time (UTC)' (or 'OPEN'), 'Participant', 'Experiment', 'Strategy', 'Cycle', 'Contract Ticker', 'Side' (UP/DOWN), 'Contracts' (size), 'Entry Price ($)', 'Exit Price ($)', 'Total Cost ($)', 'Gross Profit ($)' (pre-fee), 'Fees Paid ($)' (entry + exit), 'Net Profit ($)' (post-fee), 'Exit Reason' (take_profit, stop_loss, settle_win, settle_loss, scaled_zombie_cutoff), and 'Outcome' (WIN/LOSS/OPEN).

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
    t.trade_id AS "Trade #",
    strftime('%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%SZ', t.opened_at_ms / 1000.0, 'unixepoch') AS "Opened Time (UTC)",
    CASE WHEN t.closed_at_ms IS NOT NULL
         THEN strftime('%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%SZ', t.closed_at_ms / 1000.0, 'unixepoch')
         ELSE 'OPEN' END AS "Closed Time (UTC)",
    t.participant_id AS "Participant",
    t.experiment_id AS "Experiment",
    t.strategy_id AS "Strategy",
    t.cycle_id AS "Cycle",
    t.ticker AS "Contract Ticker",
    UPPER(t.side) AS "Side",
    t.contracts AS "Contracts",
    ROUND(t.entry_price, 4) AS "Entry Price ($)",
    CASE WHEN t.exit_price IS NOT NULL THEN ROUND(t.exit_price, 4) ELSE NULL END AS "Exit Price ($)",
    ROUND(t.cost, 2) AS "Total Cost ($)",
    ROUND(COALESCE(t.gross_pnl, t.pnl), 2) AS "Gross Profit ($)",
    ROUND(COALESCE(t.total_fee, 0.0), 2) AS "Fees Paid ($)",
    ROUND(t.pnl, 2) AS "Net Profit ($)",
    COALESCE(t.exit_reason, 'open') AS "Exit Reason",
    CASE WHEN t.won = 1 THEN 'WIN'
         WHEN t.won = 0 THEN 'LOSS'
         ELSE 'OPEN' END AS "Outcome"
FROM v_grafana_trades t
JOIN v_grafana_experiments e ON t.participant_id = e.participant_id AND t.experiment_id = e.experiment_id
WHERE ('$participant' = 'All' OR t.participant_id = '$participant')
  AND ('$strategy' = 'All' OR t.strategy_id = '$strategy')
  AND ('$experiment' = 'All' OR t.experiment_id = '$experiment')
  AND ('$cohort_status' = 'all' OR e.status = '$cohort_status')
ORDER BY t.opened_at_ms DESC, t.trade_id DESC
LIMIT 100;

    CASE WHEN t.closed_at_ms IS NOT NULL
         THEN strftime('%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%SZ', t.closed_at_ms / 1000.0, 'unixepoch')
         ELSE 'OPEN' END AS "Closed Time (UTC)",
    t.participant_id AS "Participant",
    t.experiment_id AS "Experiment",
    t.strategy_id AS "Strategy",
    t.cycle_id AS "Cycle",
    t.ticker AS "Contract Ticker",
    UPPER(t.side) AS "Side",
    t.contracts AS "Contracts",
    ROUND(t.entry_price, 4) AS "Entry Price ($)",
    CASE WHEN t.exit_price IS NOT NULL THEN ROUND(t.exit_price, 4) ELSE NULL END AS "Exit Price ($)",
    ROUND(t.cost, 2) AS "Total Cost ($)",
    ROUND(COALESCE(t.gross_pnl, t.pnl), 2) AS "Gross Profit ($)",
    ROUND(COALESCE(t.total_fee, 0.0), 2) AS "Fees Paid ($)",
    ROUND(t.pnl, 2) AS "Net Profit ($)",
    COALESCE(t.exit_reason, 'open') AS "Exit Reason",
    CASE WHEN t.won = 1 THEN 'WIN'
         WHEN t.won = 0 THEN 'LOSS'
         ELSE 'OPEN' END AS "Outcome"
FROM v_grafana_trades t
JOIN v_grafana_experiments e ON t.participant_id = e.participant_id AND t.experiment_id = e.experiment_id
WHERE ('$participant' = 'All' OR t.participant_id = '$participant')
  AND ('$strategy' = 'All' OR t.strategy_id = '$strategy')
  AND ('$experiment' = 'All' OR t.experiment_id = '$experiment')
  AND ('$cohort_status' = 'all' OR e.status = '$cohort_status')
ORDER BY t.opened_at_ms DESC, t.trade_id DESC
LIMIT 100;

panels.title: Panel 5 — 15-Minute BTC Cycles, Vixxy Locks & Official Kalshi Settlements
panels.description: 15-Minute BTC Cycle Registry reconciling Vixxy directional lock predictions against official Kalshi contract settlements. Columns: 'Cycle' (canonical key), 'Contract Ticker', 'BTC Open Strike ($)' (baseline strike set at cycle start), 'Latest BTC Spot ($)' (last spot price), 'Spot vs Strike ($)' (spot minus strike; positive favors UP), 'Cycle State' (SEARCHING/LOCKED_UP/LOCKED_DOWN), 'Vixxy Locked Direction', 'Lock Confidence (%)', 'Reversal Risk (%)', 'Kalshi Market Status' (active/settled), 'Official Settlement' (yes/no/unsettled), 'Lock Outcome' (CORRECT/INCORRECT/PENDING/NO_LOCK), 'First Seen (UTC)', and 'Last Seen (UTC)'.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
    cycle_key AS "Cycle",
    COALESCE(contract_id, '-') AS "Contract Ticker",
    ROUND(open_strike, 2) AS "BTC Open Strike ($)",
    ROUND(latest_spot, 2) AS "Latest BTC Spot ($)",
    CASE WHEN latest_spot IS NOT NULL AND open_strike IS NOT NULL
         THEN ROUND(latest_spot - open_strike, 2)
         ELSE NULL END AS "Spot vs Strike ($)",
    COALESCE(current_state, 'SEARCHING') AS "Cycle State",
    UPPER(COALESCE(locked_direction, '-')) AS "Vixxy Locked Direction",
    ROUND(locked_confidence, 1) AS "Lock Confidence (%)",
    ROUND(locked_reversal_risk, 1) AS "Reversal Risk (%)",
    COALESCE(market_status, 'active') AS "Kalshi Market Status",
    COALESCE(market_result, 'unsettled') AS "Official Settlement",
    CASE
        WHEN locked_direction IS NULL THEN 'NO_LOCK'
        WHEN market_result IS NULL OR UPPER(market_result) IN ('UNSETTLED', '') THEN 'PENDING'
        WHEN (UPPER(locked_direction) = 'UP' AND UPPER(market_result) IN ('YES', 'UP'))
          OR (UPPER(locked_direction) = 'DOWN' AND UPPER(market_result) IN ('NO', 'DOWN'))
        THEN 'CORRECT'
        ELSE 'INCORRECT'
    END AS "Lock Outcome",
    strftime('%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%SZ', first_seen_ms / 1000.0, 'unixepoch') AS "First Seen (UTC)",
    strftime('%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%SZ', last_seen_ms / 1000.0, 'unixepoch') AS "Last Seen (UTC)"
FROM cycles
ORDER BY last_seen_ms DESC
LIMIT 50;

panels.title: Panel 6 — BYOC Live & Dry-Run Action Sink Audit Log
panels.description: Audit Log of all BYOC (Bring-Your-Own-Credentials) live and dry-run action sink executions. Tracks venue fee handshakes, risk cap adjustments, and last-mile net-return veto decisions before orders reach exchange. Columns: 'Time (UTC)', 'Action Sink', 'Experiment', 'Strategy', 'Action' (BUY/SELL), 'Contract Ticker', 'Side', 'Requested Contracts', 'Executed Contracts' (reduced by risk caps if triggered), 'Order Price ($)', 'Notional ($)', 'Estimated Fee ($)', 'Execution Status' (EXECUTED/DRY_RUN/VETOED), 'Circuit Breaker / Status Reason' (veto rationale), and 'Kalshi Order ID'.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
    strftime('%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%SZ', created_at_ms / 1000.0, 'unixepoch') AS "Time (UTC)",
    sink_id AS "Action Sink",
    experiment_id AS "Experiment",
    strategy_name AS "Strategy",
    action_type AS "Action",
    ticker AS "Contract Ticker",
    UPPER(side) AS "Side",
    requested_contracts AS "Requested Contracts",
    executed_contracts AS "Executed Contracts",
    ROUND(price, 4) AS "Order Price ($)",
    ROUND(notional_dollars, 2) AS "Notional ($)",
    ROUND(fee_dollars, 4) AS "Estimated Fee ($)",
    status AS "Execution Status",
    COALESCE(reason, 'OK') AS "Circuit Breaker / Status Reason",
    COALESCE(external_order_id, '-') AS "Kalshi Order ID"
FROM action_executions
WHERE ('$strategy' = 'All' OR strategy_name = '$strategy' OR strategy_name = '*')
  AND ('$experiment' = 'All' OR experiment_id = '$experiment' OR experiment_id = '*')
ORDER BY created_at_ms DESC, execution_id DESC
LIMIT 100;
